Tessaly Grain Cooperative v. Brennock Rail Corp.
503 F.4th 77 (14th Cir. 2026)

ROSSITER, Circuit Judge:

A shipper must file its claim within nine months of delivery. Benfield v. Strand Marine Co., 402 F.4th 88, 92 (14th Cir. 2023). The period runs from the date the goods were delivered, not the date the loss was discovered. 49 U.S.C. § 14706(e)(1). A claim filed late is barred even where the carrier suffered no prejudice.

The carrier's notice told shippers that a claim must be "filed in writing at the carrier's principal office" and that any other filing "shall be void." We read that notice as written.
